simple.meaning: דְּבַשׁ (dᵉbash) appears 54 times in the Hebrew Scriptures as a person-name in the Hebrew text. The occurrence trail connects the name with an offering.
simple.biblicalBackground: The first appearances are in Genesis, Exodus, Leviticus, Numbers, Deuteronomy, and 14 more, beginning at Genesis 43:11. BibleIQ detects the main surrounding context as family, offering, land, Egypt, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to דְּבַשׁ (H1706) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: People in Scripture are understood by their place in the story. BibleIQ follows דְּבַשׁ through the actual verses so the reader sees the person in context instead of as an isolated dictionary entry.
